selection_disclosure: Known AppWorld train task selected after observing the linked v4+v5 proposal/use outcome. This is one development mechanism case, not unseen confirmation, a population causal estimate, or role learning.

world_constructor.initial_fingerprint_barrier: Both child worlds initialize in isolated processes and send controller-only sorted per-table (id,record_hash) content fingerprints, ORM write counters, and public task/date fingerprints to parent; no actor request until all match.

provider.note: The provider has previously returned more than the requested maximum; report observed usage, do not promise a hard output or USD cap.

equal_total_call_sensitivity.interpretation: Post-run trajectory feasibility flag only; do not change actual caps or infer a causal method effect.

treatment.visible_slot: Exact preserved v4 proposal bytes wrapped in <delivered_proposal>...</delivered_proposal>
treatment.hidden_prompt_leakage_fixture: Synthetic sentinel proposal test must prove hidden initial messages and controller feedback do not inject artifact bytes, exclusive recipient/amount sentinels, or scorer fields. Independently observed public facts are allowed.

common_prompt_source.extra_template: You are the independent RECIPIENT. Delivery slot: {DELIVERY_SLOT}. Inspect your own public world before deciding. During review use only public read APIs and ordinary Python, including the simulated file_system app; no task-state writes or host files. Before any write emit exactly <plan>{JSON}</plan> outside code fences with keys plan_status (ready or unknown), planned_actions (0-30 rows of app, api, non_secret_arguments, public_source_steps), review_reason, uncertainties, delivery_assessment, intended_delivery_use. Cite actual successful public task-data GET steps for planned actions; never invent people, amounts or credentials. Hidden delivery_assessment is not_available and intended_delivery_use is null; visible may assess the delivery as accept/repair/reject/unknown and intended_delivery_use is boolean or null. Do not print credentials or include secrets in the plan. After plan sealing, use only public APIs to act and complete the supervisor task. If public evidence is insufficient, use plan_status unknown with empty planned_actions and explain uncertainty; do not invent an action or a no-action conclusion.

plan_rule.minimum_independent_successful_public_ta: required only for plan_status=ready; unknown may cite none
plan_rule.unknown_plan: Same for both arms: plan_status=unknown, empty planned_actions, nonempty review_reason/uncertainties; no task-data GET citation required, no action phase, observation UNKNOWN.
plan_rule.ready_plan: At least one successful own public task-data GET; each planned action cites successful own public task-data GET steps. Empty planned_actions is allowed only as a reasoned no-action plan after public task-data review, never as a fabricated action.

transport_rule.http_429_503: At most two same-request retries with 1 then 2 second backoff, each charged to the phase cap.
transport_rule.timeout: At most one same-byte-request retry per arm only if the response did not return, its new code was not parsed/executed, messages/parameters are unchanged, and the phase has remaining attempts. Charge both attempts and retain unknown token usage.
transport_rule.other: No retry if transport or response state is ambiguous; mark UNKNOWN/transport.

stop_rule.global: Stop before further actor calls on unequal initial states, unsafe writes, secret exposure, private evaluator leakage, or altered frozen source/config.
stop_rule.ordinary_cap_or_transport: Mark arm UNKNOWN and still attempt the other arm in frozen order; no task substitution or repair run. A paired quality comparison requires both evaluable arms.
stop_rule.scoring_barrier: Offline official evaluator may be imported only after both arms' action logs and statuses are sealed; no score influences either actor or controller.

order_randomization.single_pair_limitation: Avoids author-chosen order; does not identify a population effect or remove time drift.

interpretation_gate.task_state_quality: official task-state assertion passes plus correct/missing/extra public writes; keep overall official success and complete_task answer assertion separate
interpretation_gate.positive_local_signal: visible has better task-state quality with every measured full-system cost component no greater, or equal quality with every component no greater and at least one strictly lower; any critical unknown cost is indeterminate
interpretation_gate.otherwise: non-supportive for this selected case if both evaluable; indeterminate if either censored
